hero.heading: About the club
hero.intro: We’re a welcoming bridge club in Perth’s northern suburbs, with regular sessions for players at different stages of the game.

introCard.heading: More than a game
paragraphs: With more than 350 members, Joondalup Bridge Club brings together new players, returning players and experienced duplicate pairs.
We play at Fleur Freame Pavilion in MacDonald Reserve, Padbury. Visitors are welcome at our sessions.
